text:
Maya P.: Quick sync — finalizing ReadySet GA criteria. Need concrete answers on SLA targets, docs, support runbooks, monitoring alerts, pricing page + migration guide. Can we call out owners?

Tom L.: For SLA — leaning to 99.9% monthly uptime for Hosted, p95 latency <150ms. For Dedicated we can promise 99.95 and better p95. Need legal signoff on credits.

Jordan R.: 99.9 sounds reasonable for Hosted. We should define error budget policy and automated rollback triggers. Suggest: if 5xx rate >0.2% over 5m -> auto-fallback to v2-compat model and page SRE.

Priya S.: On support: we need triage runbooks, severity matrix, internal training deck, and a customer-facing KB article for onboarding. Also an escalation flow for Dedicated/Private.

Tom L.: I'll own the rollback/runbook drafts. Draft SLA snippet below for review:
```
SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime for Hosted. Service credits apply if uptime < SLA. Exclusions: planned maintenance, customer misconfiguration, force majeure. Latency targets documented per route.
```

Oncall Bot: Deployment 1784128300 by tom-l completed to prod-readyset. No errors reported.

Maya P.: Good. Monitoring needs: latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate (5xx/4xx), request queue length, GPU util, and cache hit rate. Proposed alert thresholds: p95 >200ms OR errors >0.5% -> P1 incident.

Jordan R.: Add model-quality regression alerts too — daily eval job publishing drift score. If regression >3% vs baseline -> P2. I'll prototype the eval job and hook it into the Console.

Priya S.: For pricing page we need clear examples: per-token burst pricing, reserved capacity tiers, and a calculator for typical workloads. Also copy for migration path (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private). Ops to map support tiers to SLAs.

Maya P.: Owners: SLA doc -> Tom L.; Support runbooks + training -> Priya S.; Monitoring dashboards + eval job -> Jordan R.; Pricing copy + migration examples -> Maya P. Please ack with ETA.

Tom L.: Ack. SLA draft by EOD Thu. Will include error budget and rollback playbook.

Jordan R.: Ack. Eval job prototype + dashboard by next Tue.

Priya S.: Ack. Draft support training + KB early next week.

Maya P.: Thanks. Small follow-up — we need legal to review SLA wording and customer-facing commitments. Will loop in @legal and set a review slot. :thumbsup:
